title: SmartSlot
description: SmartSlot – Press a Number, Get Your Item Instantly
body:
**Take full control of your hotbar with SmartSlot:**

- Multiple items per number: Link more than one item to a single hotbar slot.
- Automatic selection: SmartSlot picks the closest item in your hotbar automatically.
- --
 **Example:**
- **Slot 1 → white_wool or green_wool.**
- **If white_wool is in slot 4 and green_wool in slot 6**
- **SmartSlot selects slot 4.**
- --
- **Play smarter:** **_Save time during PvP, building, or looting._**
  
- **Pair it with [GhostHotbar](https://modrinth.com/mod/ghosthotbar):**
**_[GhostHotbar](https://modrinth.com/mod/ghosthotbar) hides your hotbar by default.
This prevents confusion between your real hotbar and SmartSlot selections.
Items are chosen automatically even when the hotbar is hidden, giving a cleaner screen and faster reactions._**
  
~~**Upgrade your hotbar. Play smarter, faster, and with zero distraction.**~~

- --


<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

**It may take a moment to get used to, but if your hotbar is already organized, SmartSlot will feel seamless.**

</details>


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

In popular pvp servers, this mod may be bannable (use it at your own risk!)

</details>
